title: Load an entire report or preserve the old one
prompt: Report::load reads zero or more id|quantity lines. Id must be positive and unique; quantity must be 0..1000; at most 100 lines. Numbers must be complete decimal integers. On any invalid line or input I/O error return false and keep every old record. On success replace all records, including with an empty report. total() returns long long. No concurrent callers.
signature: class Report: bool load(std::istream&), size_t size() const, long long total() const

tests.label: Invalid replacement rolls back
tests.hint: A duplicate must leave old rows unchanged.

tests.label: Empty replacement
tests.hint: An empty valid input is a successful replacement.

tests.label: Hundred-row limit
tests.hint: Reject row 101 without publishing partial data.

hints: Parse into a local vector and set of ids.
Swap the accepted vector with the old one only after the entire input succeeds.
explanation: The local candidate owns records until the last check. Its swap is the single publication point: failed parse leaves the old report intact, while a valid empty input clears it.
